title: Incident deconvolution capacity pull - regional GPU saturation and throttle slices
sheet_summary: Purpose: ad-hoc data pull to decompose a cross-region capacity incident (2026-09-04 22:00 UTC -> 2026-09-05 03:00 UTC) that produced elevated queue depth and automated throttles. Scope: capture per-request routing, GPU host telemetry, autoscaler events, throttle logs, and KV-cache eviction counts to find root contributors to sustained queueing and cascading throttles. This sheet aggregates 1s and 1m resolution telemetry and a sampled trace set for full-request debugging.
sql_examples:
-- join telemetry + throttle + autoscaler events
SELECT t.event_ts, t.region, t.gpu_host, r.model, r.variant, g.queue_depth, g.gpu_util_pct, th.throttle_reason, th.throttle_count, a.scale_event_type, a.scale_delta
FROM telemetry.request_routes r
JOIN telemetry.gpu_metrics g ON r.gpu_host = g.host AND ABS(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(r.event_ts, g.event_ts, SECOND)) <= 30
LEFT JOIN telemetry.throttle_events th ON r.request_id = th.request_id
LEFT JOIN telemetry.autoscaler_events a ON a.region = r.region AND a.event_ts BETWEEN r.event_ts - INTERVAL '10' MINUTE AND r.event_ts + INTERVAL '10' MINUTE
WHERE r.event_ts BETWEEN '2026-09-04T22:00:00Z' AND '2026-09-05T03:00:00Z'
AND r.region IN ('us-west-2','eu-west-1')
ORDER BY r.event_ts ASC
LIMIT 2000;
key_findings:
- Spike window: ~2026-09-04T23:30Z to 2026-09-05T00:15Z in us-west-2, sustained queue_depth > 60 on multiple hosts.
- Primary load: long-context chat completions (chat-xl v2) produced high tokens_generated per request; average token per request in spike ~6x baseline.
- Autoscaler behaviour: scale-up events were emitted but effective capacity lagged due to instance provisioning cooldown + cloud API throttling; observed 'a_scale_delay' events with scale_delta not materializing for 9-12 minutes.
- Throttle cascade: cost-tier fallback throttle triggered when queue exceeded threshold; fallback routing increased load on smaller-hosted variant replicas in eu-west-1, producing cross-region spillover and subsequent KV cache churn.
- KV cache: eviction counts increased ~8x during spike for chat-xl v2 variants in eu-west-1, reducing prefix cache hits and increasing per-request compute.
- Correlation: high queue_depth strongly correlated (r~0.78) with hosts showing gpu_util_pct > 85% and kv_cache_evict_count > 3 in the same minute.
next_steps: 1) Short-term: raise canary autoscaler target for chat-xl v2 during overnight windows; temporarily relax scale-down cooldown. 2) Medium-term: add pre-warming hooks for known long-context workloads + prioritize scale-up commit path to avoid cloud API throttling. 3) Throttle policy change: invert fallback priority to avoid routing to smallest variants during region saturation. 4) Add additional trace sampling for requests that hit throttle_reason != NULL and include full prefix+kv keys in sanitized debug payloads. 5) Run replay test with synthetic long-context traffic to validate fixes (ticket JIRA-INC-7892).
